title: chargeback.created v1
description: billing-service -> Kafka topic `chargeback.created` -> risk engine (docs/adr/0005). Message value = this JSON (UTF-8), message key = transaction_id. Unknown fields are ignored by the consumer (adding an optional field is not a breaking change); a breaking change gets schema_version 2.

event_id.description: unique per event (billing's outbox id); a redelivered event has the same id and is counted once

transaction_id.description: the same id billing sent to POST /v2/assess for this payment

amount_minor.description: disputed amount in minor units (paise, cents); may be less than the payment (partial chargeback)

reason.description: billing's reason category, e.g. fraud, product_not_received, duplicate, other

created_at.description: when billing recorded the chargeback, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset
